UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Stores user account information including roles and permissions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user account (Firebase UID).

isAdmin.description: Flag indicating if the user has administrative privileges.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the account was last updated.

definition.description: Stores private user profile and role information.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure uses path-based ownership for user accounts. The isAdmin flag is stored in the user document to allow the application to perform client-side and server-side authorization checks.
